description: This file defines a custom exception class AccountingRuleInvalidDeleteException used in the Apache Fineract accounting rule module. It extends the AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and is thrown when an invalid delete operation related to accounting rules or GL closure occurs.

classes.name: AccountingRuleInvalidDeleteException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an invalid delete operation for accounting rules, specifically relating to GL closure dates.

methods.name: AccountingRuleInvalidDeleteException
methods.description: Constructor that constructs the exception with specific details about the invalid delete attempt, including office ID, office name, and the latest closure date.

calls: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
